description: GODOOR, a delivery efficiency app that uses Zenrin residential maps for package management. This app displays package information as pins on Zenrin residential maps, which show building and nameplate names, allowing you to compare package information with the residential map. It supports delivery route planning and helps prevent misdeliveries. 30-Day Free Trial! All paid features, including Zenrin residential map viewing, are available for free for 30 days upon initial paid registration. What you can do with GODOOR: • Zenrin residential map / Map display easy to use for delivery • Easy package registration • Smooth package management • Car navigation to the entrance of the delivery location • Delivery memo / Nameplate information management Detailed GODOOR functions: ■ Zenrin residential map / Standard map easy to use for delivery • Zenrin residential maps for all areas in Japan are available • Displays building names / nameplates and tenant names • Displays entrance information and private roads • Standard map design that makes it easy to understand information necessary for delivery, such as street numbers and roads ■ Easy package registration • Select and register a location from the Zenrin residential map • Registration by reading the address from a photo of the delivery slip • Supports text input as well as voice input • Can register locations even before address formatting is done on the Zenrin residential map ■ Smooth package management • The number of packages is always displayed on the standard map / Zenrin residential map • Package delivery status is: Delivered / Absent / Redelivery / Collection / Completed Managed by - Delivery time slot/delivery status is displayed as a pin on the regular map/Zenrin residential map - Status and delivery time slot changes for completed/absent/redelivery are easily managed - Display any desired package on the regular map/Zenrin residential map using the package filtering function - Registration of whether delivery to a designated location or delivery box is possible - Seamless viewing of package information and Zenrin residential map ■ Car navigation to delivery destination - Launch car navigation with one tap from package information - Navigate the car route to the delivery destination - Implements high-quality car navigation using Zenrin maps ■ Delivery memo/nameplate information management - Notes regarding the delivery destination can be registered as "Delivery Memo" - Supplementary information regarding nameplates is managed in the "Nameplate" section - Delivery Notes and nameplate notes can be viewed anytime during the next delivery. Recommended for: ■ Light cargo delivery drivers ■ Motorcycle courier drivers ■ Food delivery, takeout, and delivery drivers ■ Those who use Zenrin residential maps for delivery work Convenient in these situations: ■ Want to digitize booklet/paper Zenrin residential maps ■ Want to manage package information on Zenrin residential maps ■ Want to avoid the hassle of entering delivery addresses into car navigation systems ■ Residential maps are difficult to see in the dark during nighttime deliveries ■ Want a tool that can be easily operated with one hand even during deliveries About Zenrin Residential Maps: Zenrin residential maps provide comprehensive regional and housing information for 1,741 municipalities throughout Japan, based on on-site surveys by specialized staff. Updates are carried out regularly, annually in urban areas and every 2-5 years in other areas. Zenrin residential maps always deliver the latest data. Zenrin residential maps are used by a wide range of customers as infrastructure supporting businesses such as delivery, distribution, and door-to-door sales. About Zenrin Residential Map/Regular Map Updates Both regular maps and Zenrin residential maps are updated with the latest information as soon as Zenrin updates the map data. For inquiries about map information, please contact (Zenrin customer service). Recommended Supported OS: 9 or higher About Using Paid Features: ・Uses Google Play's subscription function ・To stop automatic updates, please go to Google Play Settings -> "Subscriptions" ■Notes ・Please register one account per user in accordance with the terms of service. We cannot guarantee proper operation if multiple people share an account. ・This application requires an internet connection via 3G/4G/5G or Wi-Fi. ・Please use safely by observing traffic rules and usage precautions. Operating a mobile phone (including looking at it; the same applies hereinafter) while driving a car, motorcycle, bicycle, etc., is extremely dangerous. If you need to use a mobile phone, please have a passenger use it or stop the vehicle in a safe location. * Please note that looking at a mobile phone while driving may violate traffic laws. We will not be held responsible for any accidents or incidents that occur while you are using your mobile phone.
